++++++++SAR K2 .45 ACP +2 Magazine Extension by DB Firearms++++++++


This is a simple +2 magazine extension for the SAR K2 chambered in .45ACP. This extension will replace your factory baseplate and floorplate. Just remove the old ones, slide this on, and add a small screw at the back to prevent the magazine body from falling out.
